+ देव भूमि- + देव, m. a Brāhmaṇa,
+ नाथ भूमि- + नाथ, m. a king,
Lass. 14, 20
+ पक्ष भूमि- + पक्ष, m. a swift horse.
+ पति भूमी- + पति, m. the same.
I. i. e. भू + मन्, n. The earth,

= Rigv. i. 85 5.
 II. i. e. बहु + इमन्, m. Multitude, majority,
Rājat. 5, 165

.
 --Cf. Lat. hŭmus, hŭmilis.

भू + मय,
 I. adj., f. यी, Made or consisting of earth.
 II. f. यी, A name of छाया, or shadow personified, the wife of the sun.

भूमि (also भूमी, i. e. भू + म + ई, cf.
 I. भूमन्), f.
 1. The earth, Pañc. 165, 16.
 2. Land, estate, Pañc. iii. d. 92; domain (where one governs or works), Bhāg.

. Place, Pañc. 161, 13; site.
 --Comp.

भूमि + का, f.
 1. Change-of costume in order to represent a different character on the stage.
 2. Decorating images, temples, gateways, etc.
 3. A story; ग्रिहोपरिभूमिकायाम् आरुढः, He mounted to the upper story of the house, Śukas. cod. Petersb. p. 31, b.
 4. A preface to a book.
 --Comp.

भूमि-ज,
 I. adj. Born on the earth.
 II. m.
 1. The planet

Mars.
 2

. Hell.
 III. f. जा, Sītā, the wife of Rāma.
भूमिष्ठ, i. e. भूमि-स्थ, adj. Standing or staying on the earth,

भूमि-स्पृश्. m.
 1. A man, mankind.
 2. A vaiśya.
 3. A thief, one who creeps along the ground to carry off his plunder.
 4. A blind man.
 5. A cripple.
+ रक्षक भूमि- + रक्षक, m. a swift horse.
+ लेपन भूमि- + लेपन, n. cow-dung.
+ संनिवेश भूमि- + संनिवेश, m. the shape, face of a region, Utt.
Rāmac. 47, 4
